Commentary.Commentary: The Windies now have a lot of time left in the game. They will look to bat for as long as possible and bat Bangladesh out of the game. For the visitors, quick wickets is the call of the hour as they cannot allow the hosts to put up another decent score on the board. Join us for the Windies second innings in a while.

Tamim Iqbal though continued his innings, this time with Mushfiqur Rahim. But just as the partnership started flourishing, the debutant, Keemo Paul got his maiden Test wicket in the form of Iqbal and on the very next ball trapped Nurul Hasan in front. Nobody from the lower order contributed with Holder picking 3 of the remaining 4 and finishing with a fifer.

So, the Windies have not enforced the follow-on. They will be batting once again with a lead of 205. Their bowlers were clinical throughout. All the pacers chipped in with the wickets. Gabriel started the proceedings by taking two in one over. Tamim and Shakib did try to steady the ship with a 59-run stand but then Holder provided another double wicket over.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Fifer for Holder, his third in Tests! Brilliant by him. He goes full and straight on middle, it straightens after pitching. Jayed tries to work it through the leg side but misses to see his stumps get shattered. BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 149!
Full and outside off, the batsman goes for the drive but does not connect.
Down the leg side, the ball hits the pads of the batsman and goes to the keeper.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shorter in length on off, the batsman pushes it to mid on.
Full and outside off, the batsman swings but misses.
Back of a length on off, this one straightens. Islam tries to keep it out but gets beaten.
Abu Jayed is the last man in.

OUT! Drags it on! Holder gets Taijul for the second time in this game. This time though he does not overstep. 4th wicket for him. This is on a length around off, it shapes back. Taijul tries to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto his stumps. Bangladesh need 6 more to avoid the follow-on and they have a wicket in hand.
This time he eases it to mid on off the middle.
Not afraid to play his shots is the southpaw. Holder bowls it full and outside off, Taijul slashes but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
FOUR! Islam is dealing in boundaries! Full and on the pads, he flicks it stylishly through mid-wicket for another boundary.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it onto the ground.
Down the leg side, Islam misses the flick.
Attacks the off stump, the batsman gets behind the line of it and defends it.
Full and outside off, Kamrul does the right thing. LEAVES IT.
The sucker ball, full and outside off. The batsman does go after it but does not connect.
Good length again on off, Islam tries to defend but gets an outside edge to gully.
Shorter in length outside off, the batsman goes fishing after it but does not connect.
Second time in a row he has overstepped! It was bowled on a length, the batsman pokes at it and gets beaten.
Another no ball as the bowler has overstepped. He bangs it in short and the batsman evades it.
Shorter in length outside off, the batsman lets it be.
FOUR! Inching closer to avoiding the follow-on. Full and on middle once again. Taijul times it back past the bowler and fetches another boundary. Second in the over.
Another yorker on off, Taijul does really well to get his bat down in time and jam it out.
A yorker on the stumps, the batsman jams it out.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! These are very handy runs for Bangladesh! They need another 16 to avoid the follow-on. Full and on middle, Taijul strokes it through mid on and the ball races away.
Back of a length on off, Islam guides it to point.
Fullish ball around off, Islam covers the line and keeps it out.
Angling in appreciably, clipped towards mid-wicket.
Time for Drinks! Meanwhile, Kamrul Islam is the new man in.

OUT! No, the height is fine! Good length ball around off, shaping in. Mehidy Hasan rises on his toes to block it but misses to get hit above the knee roll on the back leg. Cummins along with his teammates go up in unison and the umpire obliges. However, Hasan after a chat with his partner signals the 'T'. Time for the replays. There is nothing on the Snicko. Now, the Hawk Eye shows that the impact is umpire's call and the ball is clipping the top of off. The decision stays and Mehidy is on his way back.
Time for a review! Mehidy Hasan has been adjudged LBW but he has challenged the decision. Is height a factor?
On the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Fullish ball around off, Islam pushes at it but gets an outside edge that goes past Shai Hope at gully and runs to the fence behind.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, Mehidy misses his flick.
Hops in the crease and turns it around the corner for a run.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.

Bowled off a no ball! The issue of overstepping once again knocks on the door of the Windies. Holder attacks the stumps with a full length ball and gets it to move away a touch. Islam pushes at it but misses to get cleaned up. Holder is celebrating but the umpire refers it upstairs to check for the front foot no ball. The replays roll in. Well, there is nothing behind the popping crease. Holder has his hands on his head in disappointement. The bowling coach, Corey Collymore in the dressing room has his head down. This is a serious issue which needs to be sorted out soon.
Taijul Islam walks out to the middle.

OUT! The skipper gets a 3-fer! Shortish ball outside off, rising on Rahim. He tries to ride the bounce but isn't able to do so properly. The ball flies towards the gully region. Shai Hope stationed in that region is cool as a cucumber as he dives to his right to take a sharp catch. There is anguish written on the face of Mushfiqur. Should have carried on after getting a start.
Fullish delivery around off, Mehidy eases it to covers for a single.
In the zone outside off, Mehidy lets it go.
Jason Holder is back on.
Where did that come from? Pitches on a back of a length and takes off like an aeroplane. Rahim watches it sail into the gloves of the keeper.
FOUR! Whacked! Short and room on offer, Rahim frees his arms and unfurls a fierce cut through point for a rocketing boundary.
Good length ball around off, Rahim covers the line and blocks it.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
False stroke! Overpitched outside off, Rahim goes for a drive but gets an inside edge onto his boot.
On a length, shaping in from outside off, Rahim comes forward and defends it with authority.
Keemo Paul is going off the field. The physio is along with him and has a chat as well. He looked in some sort of discomfort in his previous over. Might be a sprain.
A play and a miss! Pitched up ball outside off, Mehidy goes for a push but misses.
Around off stump, Hasan covers the line to block it.
Full ball on middle and leg, Mehidy closes his bat face early as he tries to whip it across but gets a leading edge. Paul dives to his left but the ball goes past him. A couple taken.
Fuller in length on off, Hasan drives it back to the bowler.
Length again on off, Hasan defends it off the front foot.
On a fuller length on middle, Hasan tries to drive but gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Good length ball outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
Fullish delivery, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard! Short and width on offer, Rahim pounces on it and flays it over backward point to pick up a boundary.
On a length, defended solidly off the back foot.
Angling in sharply, Rahim tries to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Cummins starts appealing but bails out of it quickly.
Miguel Cummins is back on.
Covers the line to this one and keeps it out.
Almost a hat-trick on his debut! Pitches on middle and off and swings away like a banana. Mehidy pokes at it and misses.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in. He will be facing the hat-trick ball. Can Keemo Paul take a hat-trick on debut?

OUT! The procession continues! The man who had played a good knock in the previous game bags a golden duck this time. Paul bowl this one on a length in the tight off stump corridor and the ball nips in sharply after pitching. Nurul Hasan walks down the track, shuffles a touch and tries to keep it out but misses to get hit on the pads. The Windies appeal in unison and up goes the umpire's finger. The keeper keeps on walking back to the pavilion. Well, the replay shows that the impact was outside off. Bangladesh have missed a trick once again. When you have reviews in the bag, can't fathom what is the hesitation in using them.
Nurul Hasan strides out to bat. He was promising in the previous game. Needs to do play an innings of substance here.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The sound of the ball hitting the stumps is music to the ears of a fast bowler. Wonderful skill set displayed by Keemo Paul to get his maiden Test wicket. He runs in from around the wicket and bowls a fuller length ball on off. The ball straightens just a touch as Iqbal leans ahead to defend but the ball goes past the outside edge of his bat to disturb the furniture behind. A big moment for the youngster and he is congratulated by his teammates. The veteran fails to convert his start into a big one. Bangladesh continue to slip downhill.
Beautifully bowled! He took the previous one away and brings this one in to catch Iqbal off guard. He gets squared up and gets it off the outer half of the bat towards gully.
Length ball outside off, moves away after pitching. Tamim shapes to drive but does the sensible thing to take his bat inside the line and leaves it.
Gabriel is going off the field to take a breather.
Similar length ball outside off, punched through extra cover for a single.
Back of a length on middle, tucked with a closed bat face to mid-wicket.
Still there is movement on this track. Iqbal can't afford a lapse in concentration. On a fuller length, leaving the southpaw. He leans ahead to deal with it but gets beaten.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, Mushfiqur pushes at it but the ball stays low and goes under his bat.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Gabriel seems to be losing steam. Shortish ball well outside off, Rahim rises on his toes and cuts it through cover-point to find the fence.
This one angles in nicely as Rahim gets hurried a bit but manages to keep it out to the leg side. A run taken.
Streaky! Pitches on off and straightens a touch. Rahim is opened up in his stance as he gets it off the outer half of the bat past the gully region. A couple taken.
Fuller in length, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
This is good stuff from Paul! He is probing in and around the off stump channel. Rahim covers his off stump and makes an assured leave.
Angling in towards the leg stump, Rahim gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Sanity prevails for Tamim on this occasion as he leaves the away going delivery. Another maiden for Gabriel.
Nearly chopped it on! Similar delivery, Tamim goes at it with hard hands but gets a bottom edge that goes past the off stump and rolls towards the keeper. He is looking jittery all of a sudden.
Angling away on a length from the southpaw. He tries to force it through the line but gets an inside edge beside the pitch on the leg side.
Change of bat for Tamim Iqbal.
Back of a length well outside off, Iqbal goes after it but gets no sort of timing on it. Ends up toe-ending it towards cover-point.
Angling in, Tamim tucks it with a closed bat face towards mid on.
Good length ball, angling in, Iqbal hangs back and dead-bats it.
Straighter on this occasion, Rahim is solid in his defense.
Shaping away from outside off, Mushfiqur doesn't fiddle with it.
No ball! The fifth time the Windies bowlers have overstepped in this innings. In the tight off stump channel, Rahim is watchful once again as he makes a good leave.
In the zone outside off, left alone.
No ball! Paul has overstepped on this occasion. Fullish ball, defended off the front foot.

Close shave! Full ball on off, Tamim taps it towards short mid-wicket and takes off. Roston Chase attacks the ball quickly, aims at the bowler's end but misses. The replays show that even had that hit, Tamim would have been just safe.
Good length ball outside off, tapped with an angled bat to point.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Sits back to the length ball and defends it with authority.
Once again it is on a leg stumpish line as the ball goes past Rahim's bat to ping him on the thigh pad.
FOUR! Delightful! Fractionbally overpitched on off, Rahim leans into it and times his drive to perfection. The ball rolls along the turf down the ground and races to the ropes.
Gabriel loses his radar and slips this one down the leg side. Rahim misses his flick.
Four Leg Byes! Fortunate for Bangladesh. Dug in short, Rahim tries to duck but the ball deflects off his elbow guard and goes past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Shaping in sharply from around off, Rahim defends it with his bat and pad close together.

FOUR! Edged but safe! If there was a third slip in place, he would have gobbled it up. Full ball outside off, Iqbal goes for a full-blooded drive but gets an outside edge that goes through the gap between the second slip and gully and races to the fence. The Windies should be attacking a lot more as they are a long way ahead. Can't understand the tactics of the hosts.
Tight stump-to-stump line and on a good length, defended with a straight bat.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, driven crisply to Paul who collects it on his followthrough.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Beaten all ends up! Coming in with the natural around the angle and deviates after pitching to go past the hanging bat of Tamim.
Back of a length ball, placed to point.

Ooh! Almost. On a driveable length outside off, inviting Rahim to go for a flamboyant stroke and he falls for the bait. Goes for a booming drive but there is a lot of gap between his bat and pad. The ball seams in sharply and goes right through that. It was not far from the off pole as well. Another good over from Gabriel.
Well bowled! Lands on a length and takes off with some extra bounce. Rahim hops to fend it off but get an inside edge onto his pads.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Mushfiqur Rahim makes use of the depth of the crease to stonewall it.
Gabriel goes wider of the crease and bowls another bumper. Mushfiqur ducks under it comfortably.
Banged in hard on the deck but does not rise much. Mushfiqur sits under it. The ball dies down before reaching the keeper.
Full lenth ball around off, Tamim leans into it and strokes it through covers to rotate strike.
Shannon Gabriel to continue his spell.
Pitched up ball for a change, driven crisply to mid off. A maiden for Paul.
On the fifth stump line this time, fifth leave in a row.
Another one right on the money. Back of a length on off, seaming away after hitting the deck. Rahim is once again circumspect in approach as he lets it go.
Better from Paul! In the tight off stump corridor, leaves Rahim at the last moment as he covers his off stump and lets it go.
Once again some substantial away movement but the line is wayward. It is wide outside off as Mushfiqur shoulders arms.
In the corridor of uncertainty, moves away after pitching. Rahim plants his front foot across to allow it through.

The players make their way out for the final session. We are in for a long one today as there are still 40 overs to go. Tamim Iqbal and Mushfiqur Rahim will continue their innings. Keemo Paul will start the proceedings for the Windies. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

Then, Shakib Al Hasan joined Tamim Iqbal in the middle and played some fine shots. The skipper kept on batting in the same mode, stitched a 59-run stand with the latter but Jason Holder got the better of him. The Windies captain then struck in the same over to pile the misery on the visitors. It could have been even worse had Devon Smith taken the catch of Tamim in Chase's over. He is still battling out there as Bangladesh are still 262 runs behind and have a stiff task in front of them. They need to bat out of their skins to spark any chances of a comeback. Join us shortly for the final session.

Session Highlights - 26 overs, 82 runs, 4 wickets. The Windies continue to remain in the ascendancy. Shannon Gabriel, who has been in belligerent form, was on a roll once again. He got two wickets pretty quickly. It is to be mentioned that Liton Das was a touch unlucky but he has only himself to blame as he didn't take the review.
Leg bye! Down the leg side, Rahim tries to flick but the ball brushes the thigh pad and rolls to the leg side. A run taken. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 2!
Back of a length ball, kept out from within the crease.
Full ball on the pads, clipped to fine leg for a run.
On a length outside off, left alone.

Good length ball around off, straightening after landing. Iqbal keeps his bat inside the line to let it go. The keeper is interested as there was a noise. However, the replays show that the bat hit the pad and hence, the sound.

Not Out! Umpire's call it is! The Windies do not lose a review though. Gabriel runs in from around the wicket and bowls a skiddy length ball on middle. Iqbal tries to defend it from his crease but misses to get struck on the pads. Gabriel is confident but the umpire stays put. The pacer convinces the stand-in skipper, Brathwaite (who is in charge as Holder is out of the field) to take the DRS. He obliges too. There is nothing on the Snicko. Hawk Eye rolls in and it is just clipping the leg stump. Iqbal survives.
A LBW appeal against Tamim Iqbal is taken upstairs. Gabriel eggs Brathwaite to take the review who does so. Seems like it will miss leg.
Shannon Gabriel returns for a burst. This will probably be the last over before Tea.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
This one skids through after pitching. Mushfiqur gets it off the outer half of the bat towards backward point.
On a similar length, Tamim pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length, kept out from within the crease.
Bowls this one fuller on middle, Tamim leans ahead in defense.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Going down the leg side, Iqbal gets enough bat on it to get it past the keeper and the ball rolls to the fine leg fence.
Goes fuller again on off, MR mistimes his stroke to mid off.
Good length on middle, Rahim lunges and keeps it out.
Hits the length again on off, Rahim calmly defends it towards the cover fielder.
Length on middle, Rahim defends it solidly.
Fuller in length on middle, Rahim eases it to mid on.
Back of a length outside off, Rahim guides it to backward point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full outside off, Tamim this time gets it through the gap in the cover region for a brace.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Flighted ball on off, Tamim drives it to covers.
Flatter on off, Tamim keeps it out.
Floats it up on off, Tamim drives it to covers.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Rahim seems to have got a tickle on it as the ball beats the keeper and races to the fine leg fence. He is off the mark.
On a length outside off, Rahim pushes at it but misses.
On a length, kept out watchfully.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Bangladesh are falling apart again! They lost two wickets to Gabriel in the same over and once again have been rocked by a couple of blows. Holder bowls this one on a good length in the avenue of apprehension and gets the ball to jag back in sharply after landing. Mahmudullah is caught in a tangle. He hops and tries to keep it out but misses it completely to get hit flush on the pads. Holder appeals vociferously and the umpire obliges. The visitors are still 275 behind.
Angling in from over the wicket, turned to mid-wicket.
Mahmudullah comes out to bat.

OUT! Chopped on! Holder gets his opposite number and is cock-a-hoop. It is a big one too. Just when a partnership was building up, it has been cut short. He steams in from around the wicket and bowls a length ball outside off. It skids through after pitching and swings in substantially as well. Shakib is beaten by pace and also by the movement. He tries to push it through the line but only manages an inside edge which goes onto shatter the stumps. A chancy knock from the Bangladesh captain ends.
Outside off, left alone.
Rocks back and cuts this with the spin to point.

Dropped! Opportunity created but not grabbed. How costly will this prove? Tossed up ball from around the wicket on middle and off, goes straight on. Iqbal plays for the non-existent turn and hence, gets an outside edge. Devon Smith at first slip dives to his right, gets his hands to it but fails to hold on. The ball rolls towards third man and a couple is taken.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On a flatter trajectory, Tamim hangs back in defense.
Drifting into middle and leg, Iqbal prods forward in defense.
On a length on middle and leg, once again goes past Shakib's bat to ping him on the thigh pad.
This one seams away a touch after coming in with the natural angle, Shakib is right behind it to stonewall it.
Angling down leg, the skipper tries to tuck it away but is hit on the thigh pad.
Tentative! Coming in sharply with the natural around the wicket angle, Tamim leans ahead gingerly but gets it off the inner half through square leg. A run taken.
This time the skipper plays the same shot but the difference is that it is all along the ground. A run taken.

FOUR! Run-scoring too easy for Bangladesh at the moment. Windies are on the defensive at the moment. Shortish and a lot of room outside off, Shakib gets up on his toes and slaps it over backward point. Chase in the deep runs to his right but has no chance to stop it.
Wide outside off, this time Tamim doesn't fiddle with it.
Too full and straight, clipped nicely through mid-wicket for a run.
Uses the depth of the crease to block this one.
Another expansive drive attempted by Shakib but the ball spins away sharply to fox him.
Leans ahead a touch and blocks it right under his eyes.
Outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Iqbal waits for this length ball and places it past gully for a brace. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. A much-needed one.
Signs that this surface is a two-paced one. Back of a length outside off, stays low. Iqbal keeps it out off the back foot to covers.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Peach! Lands on a length around off and straightens to go past the hanging bat of Iqbal.
Iqbal uses his feet and Holder spots that. He bowls this one wider outside off. Iqbal still drags it towards short mid-wicket. Two catching men at that position are waiting, needs to be careful.
FOUR! Crisp! Shortish ball outside off, Iqbal rises with the bounce and cuts it through covers. The timing is spot on and the ball whistles to the fence.
Fuller in length, eased to covers.
Nicely done! A fraction shorter in length, the skipper rocks back and guides it past backward point. Brathwaite from that region hares after it and saves a couple of runs for his side.
A gentle tossed up ball outside off, patted to covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Chase drags his length back as Shakib cuts it towards point. He is looking to be quite aggressive.
Floated outside off, driven crisply but straight to the man at extra cover.
Coming in with the natural angle, tucked to mid-wicket.

Another close shout! Holder bowls a length ball from around the wicket on middle and leg. Iqbal hops in order to defend it but is pinged on the pads. Holder and Co appeal for it but the umpire stays put. The skipper asks the keeper about it but he says it was high. Replays indicate that too.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad.
In the air... but safe! Short ball climbing on the skipper as he goes for the pull over mid-wicket but mistimes it over mid on. A run taken.
Well played! Short and room on offer, slapped towards deep backward point for a brace.
On middle and leg, Shakib hops and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Quicker one on middle, defended watchfully.
It's been driven superbly through the covers.
Spinning into Iqbal as he prods forward in defense.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.

A appeal for an LBW denied! Drifting in towards off. Shakib tries to clip it away but is hit on the back thigh. Chase is excited but the umpire cuts it down quickly. That was high and would have missed the off stump as well.
Poor from Shakib! This one is drifting in but spins away as well. Shakib tries to force it through the line with zero footwork and gets beaten. Wasn't far from the outside edge.
Straighter this time, Iqbal covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Full on middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.

Pitched up this time, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan drags his drive towards Holder who collects the ball in his followthrough and tries to effect a run out at his end. However, Tamim is alert and drags his bat inside the crease before the ball hits the stumps.
Similar length ball, defended from the comfort of the crease.
Shakib once again tries to assert himself as he walks down the track but this time Holder doesn't provide him much space to work with. He ends up chopping it towards point.
FOUR! As easy you like! That one disappeared at the rate of knots. A gentle back of a length ball wide outside off, Shakib stands tall and crunches it through covers for a rocketing boundary.
Jason Holder is back on.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On a flatter trajectory, kept out watchfully.

Tight run! Shakib eases this one towards covers and calls his partner through. The fielder from point gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Would have been close if it was a better throw.
Pushed wider this time, Shakib goes for a drive but mistimes it towards point.
Shorter in length, answered with a straight bat.
Slow through the air on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Drinks!
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Sprays on the pads, Shakib flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, Shakib guides it to point.
Hits the length hard on off, Shakib defends it.
Tucked to mid-wicket.
Another no ball! Cummins once again has overstepped. Full and on the stumps, Tamim uses his wrists and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller on off, Shakib drives it towards mid off for a quick run.
On middle and Shakib defends it. The bowler has overstepped and the umpire signals it a NO BALL. He has overstepped by quite a margin.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! Streaky but effective! Once again uses his feet and tries to go inside out over covers. The ball takes the outside edge and goes through third man for the second boundary of the over.
Lovely stuff! Flatter on off, this one pitches and turns away. Tamim tries to defend but is beaten.
Fires this on middle, Tamim keeps it out off the back foot.
FOUR! So Tamim will not let the spinner settle in. He uses his feet and gets to the pitch of it. Clears mid off and fetches himself a boundary. Runs starting to come thick and fast now.
Flatter on off, Tamim defends it off the back foot.
Roston Chase is into the attack.
Angles this one on the pads, Shakib misses his shot to get hit high on the pads. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire.

FOUR! Action replay of the last delivery! Back-to-back boundaries for Bangladesh. Once again it is fuller and there is width on offer outside off. Shakib Al Hasan once again hits it through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Full and wide outside off, Shakib slaps it through covers and the ball races to the fence in no time.
On the pads, Shakib tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the thigh pad.
Tucked around the corner for a run.
On a length around off, guided to point.
Good length on off, defended.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
Back of a length on off, kept out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Close! That one comes in like a banana. Full and outside off, Tamim shapes up to leave it. The ball comes in late and goes over the off pole.
FOUR! Once again not convincing but Bangladesh won't mind! Back of a length on off, Iqbal tries to punch it through the off side but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon for a boundary.
Jason Holder is into the attack.
Good length ball around leg stump, Shakib tries to work it away but is hit on the thigh pad. Cummins starts appealing but bails out of it soon.
FOUR! This time Shakib connects and connects well! Back of a length and ample room on offer. The skipper slaps it through point to find the ropes.
Nervy! Shortish ball, not that much room for Shakib but he goes for the cut. Ends up getting a bottom edge that rolls towards the keeper.
Back of a length ball, answered with a straight bat.
Similar length ball around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
On a length, angling away from Shakib. He plays it with an angled bat to point.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one.
Down the leg side, Tamim fails to flick it but misses. It brushes the pads and goes to the keeper who dives to his right and takes it. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Length around off, Tamim punches it to covers.
Good pace there! A bumper outside off, Tamim goes for the cut but the ball gets big on him and he misses.
Shorter and on off, Tamim gets on top of the bounce and defends it down.
Back of a length on middle, Tamim defends it onto the ground.
Length again on off, Shakib is solid in defense. End of a very good first over by Cummins.
Good length again on middle, Shakib defends it back to the bowler.
Another excellent delivery! On a length around middle, comes back in sharply. Shakib tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his body.
Down the leg side, Tamim misses the flick. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the square leg region for a leg bye. The umpire gives it as a run. Maybe there was an inside edge.
Good length around off, kept out.

NOT OUT! The ball has pitched outside the leg stump. Excellent use of technology by Iqbal. He survives to fight another day. This pitches around leg and then jags back in. Tamim tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises the finger. The Windies players start celebrating as Tamim has a discussion with Shakib. After a long one he signals for the 'T'. Replays roll in and it shows the ball to be pitching outside leg. A huge let off for Bangladesh as they cannot afford to lose another wicket.
Have Windies got another? Tamim has been given LBW but he decides to review it. Looks out.
Miguel Cummins is into the attack.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to the middle.

OUT! One brings two and that is exactly the case here. Mominul walks back without troubling the scorers. His lean patch with the bat continues. This is on a fuller length around middle, it straightens. Haque tries to flick but the ball takes the outside edge and goes into the hands of Hope at gully. He throws the ball up in joy and Bangladesh are in trouble here.
JAFFA to Mominul first up! In the corridor of uncertainty. Haque plays at it but is beaten by the movement away.
Mominul Haque comes out to bat.

OUT! Shannon Gabriel draws first blood! The inswinger does the trick. He goes wide of the crease and angles it into the off pole. It comes back into the batsman. Liton stays rooted to his crease and tries to drive it towards mid on. He misses and gets hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Liton thinks about a review but Tamim does not agree as it looked quite adjacent. So, Bangladesh lose an early wicket after the break and they trail by another 334. Now then, it did look adjacent to the naked eye but replays later on show, it was missing leg. Das would feel undone there and the Bangladesh dressing room looks a frustrated one after they saw that on the big screen.
Down the leg side, Das is beaten for pace as he attempts to tuck it away. It hits his pads and rolls towards square leg.
Outside off, left alone.

This time he connects with the flick shot not as he would have liked but still he gets runs. On the pads, Tamim flicks it not off the middle but enough to clear the mid-wicket fielder and the batsmen run two. A good over for Bangladesh.

Edged and runs! Full marks to the bowler there. He makes good use of the angle and bowls it on middle, it slants across the batsman who tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through backward point for a brace.
Full and outside off, this time Liton connects with the cover drive. It is not right off the middle and hence does not reach the ropes. The batsmen run three.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
OOOO! A good delivery but Liton just played a shot which maybe he could have avoided. Full and outside off, swinging away further. Das goes for a drive away from his body but misses.
Outside off, the batsman does not fiddle with it.
Angles this one into the batsman. Iqbal is late on the flick and is hit high on the pads.
Lovely stuff! Gabriel angles this into the batsman first. Which means Tamim has to play at it. The bowler gets it to straighten after pitching which beats the outside edge of the bat.
Hits the length again on off, Iqbal lunges forward and defends it.
Length outside off, Tamim plays inside the line and lets it be.
Full on the pads, Das flicks it through backward square leg. The fielder runs to his left and makes a good stop. Keeps it down to a single.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Das defends it onto the ground.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Down the leg side, once again Tamim fails to put bat on it. He will be disappointed as this is the second time he did not put a ball away which is down the leg side.
On a length around off, kept out.
NO BALL! The bowler has overstepped as he bowls it on the pads. Tamim fails to flick and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Outside off, left alone.
On the shorter side outside off, Tamim cuts it to point.
Keemo Paul who will bowl from the other end starts off with a length ball around off. Iqbal drops his wrists and lets it go.
Back of a length outside off, Das watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, Tamim mistimes his drive towards covers and crosses over.

A huge appeal but not given! On a length around off, this one comes back in after pitching. Tamim prods forward to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Seemed to be a touch high and Hawk Eye confirms that.

Another length ball way outside off, Iqbal lets it be. There was a noise as the ball went into the mitts of the keeper and an appeal from the Windies fielders followed. Nothing from the umpire and replays later on show that the noise was of the bat hitting the thigh pad.
Good length delivery outside off, Iqbal plays inside the line and lets it go through to the keeper.
Starts off with a full ball on off, Iqbal drives it to mid off.
We are back after the break. Out come the batters, Liton Das and Tamim Iqbal. The former will be on strike and he will face Shannon Gabriel who will continue his spell. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

Safely negotiated! Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das have survived the two overs and go unscathed to the dressing room to have a nice meal. Day 1 wasn't a good one for Bangladesh but they have bounced back with aplomb on Day 2 indicating that they have the potential. It is just a matter of channelizing it in the right direction. It seemed that a score in the range of 450-500 is on the cards but their bowling had a lot more intensity today. Mehidy Hasan was the most successful bowler, picking a 5-fer while Abu Jayed took 3 wickets. Windies, on the other hand, still have a competitive score on the board. They would draw inspiration from the fact that they had bowled out Bangladesh twice for just 187 runs in the last game. It will be a stern test for the tourists. Can they fight fire with fire? Join us on the other side of the break to find out.
FOUR! Authoritative! Slightly overpitched outside off, Das frees his arms and drives it crisply through extra cover to find the fence. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!

This time the line and length is ideal. Paul goes wider of the crease and bowls a length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, the ball lands and then moves away as well. Das keeps his bat inside the line to let it through.
Wide outside off and swinging away, Liton is not bothered by it.
In the channel outside off, Das lets it through.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Iqbal hops and tucks it around the corner for a single.
Some nerves on display as the youngster starts with a loosener. Slips this one down the leg side as Tamim misses his flick.
The debutant, Keemo Paul to share the new ball.
Full again on middle, but once again there is no movement for Gabriel. Das drives it back towards the bowler who stops it with his leg.
Fuller in length on off, no swing on offer for Gabriel. Das drives it towards cover-point. The fielder there fumbles but no runs taken.
Back of a length on off, Das defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Das needs no sighters. Short and outside off, Liton says thank you very much and cuts it over point. A boundary results.
Bangladesh are underway! Tamim works this with the angle through fine leg for a run.

What a delivery to bowl first up! Woah! Gabriel comes running in and bowls an inswinging yorker. Tamim is surprised by it as he fails to keep it out. The ball hits him on the pads as the batter loses his balance and falls onto the ground. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
